description: List a habit's raw check records, optionally within an inclusive date range. Each record carries checkDate 'yyyy-MM-dd' and slotId (null for single-dose and interval habits). Use to answer history questions or compute streaks — for daily habits a day counts toward a streak only when EVERY dose is checked; for interval habits read currentPeriod / currentStreak from get_habit instead of recomputing period progress from raw rows.
name: list_habit_checks
